name: EvolveX
description: EvolveX advertises a no-card community API tier.
overview: The pricing page lists a free community tier with 5 requests per minute and GitHub sign-in. Its docs list open and proprietary models but do not clearly identify which specific models are included on Free; verify eligibility in the dashboard. Homepage also describes a keyless endpoint, while pricing and docs require a key.
free_access: Documentation and homepage differ about API keys
notes: Documentation example only: free-tier eligibility not confirmed. Base URL https://api.evolvex.gg/v1.
